messages.content:
You are helping a user write SQL queries to a database. If something is not clear, you can ask the user to clarify what they need. The schema for the database being accessed is the following:
        
CREATE TABLE poker_player (
    Poker_Player_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    People_ID INT,
    Final_Table_Made REAL,
    Best_Finish REAL,
    Money_Rank REAL,
    Earnings REAL,
    UNIQUE (Poker_Player_ID),
    FOREIGN KEY (People_ID) REFERENCES people(People_ID)
);

CREATE TABLE people (
    People_ID INT   PRIMARY KEY,
    Nationality TEXT,
    Name TEXT,
    Birth_Date TEXT,
    Height REAL,
    UNIQUE (People_ID)
);

What do you mean by “famous” in your database—players with the highest **Earnings**, best **Money_Rank** (lowest number), most **Final_Table_Made**, or best **Best_Finish**?

Here are a few common SQL options you can run:

### Top players by earnings
```sql
SELECT p.Name, p.Nationality, pp.Earnings
FROM poker_player pp
JOIN people p ON p.People_ID = pp.People_ID
ORDER BY pp.Earnings DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

### Top players by money rank (1 = best)
```sql
SELECT p.Name, p.Nationality, pp.Money_Rank
FROM poker_player pp
JOIN people p ON p.People_ID = pp.People_ID
WHERE pp.Money_Rank IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pp.Money_Rank ASC
LIMIT 10;
```

### Most final tables made
```sql
SELECT p.Name, p.Nationality, pp.Final_Table_Made
FROM poker_player pp
JOIN people p ON p.People_ID = pp.People_ID
ORDER BY pp.Final_Table_Made DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

Tell me which definition you want (or the exact columns you want returned), and I’ll tailor it.
focus on the earnings of these poker players

```sql
SELECT
  p.Name,
  p.Nationality,
  pp.Earnings
FROM poker_player pp
JOIN people p
  ON p.People_ID = pp.People_ID
WHERE pp.Earnings IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pp.Earnings DESC;
```

If you want just the “most famous” (top N) earners, add a limit, e.g. `LIMIT 10`.
just show me the names and earnings ranked from highest to lowest

```sql
  p.Name,
  pp.Earnings
FROM poker_player pp
JOIN people p
  ON p.People_ID = pp.People_ID
WHERE pp.Earnings IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY pp.Earnings DESC;
```

```sql
FROM poker_player pp
```
